basalt.name: Basalt
basalt.look: A dark grey rock, heavy for its size. Dull surface.

tests.lens: Tiny crystals, too small to pick out one by one.
tests.magnet: A faint pull. Something in it is magnetic.
tests.scratch: Scratches glass. The steel nail does not mark it.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.look: Black and shiny like glass, with sharp curved edges.

tests.lens: Smooth glass. No crystals at all.
tests.streak: A pale streak, even though the rock looks black.
tests.scratch: About as hard as glass. It is glass.

pumice.name: Pumice
pumice.look: Pale grey and strangely light. Full of tiny holes.

tests.lens: Glassy, and riddled with tiny holes like a sponge.
tests.scratch: Hard to test. The edges crumble.
